problem:
Given that the mean of the following data set is $11,$ find the value of $c:$ 

$$
(c-3),\,6,\,3,\,c,\,10,\,20
$$
worked_solution:
If we have a data set that consists of the points ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},…,{x}_{n},$ then the mean is denoted by $\overset{―}{x}$ and is given by the following formula:

$$
\overset{―}{x}=\frac{1}{n}{\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{x}_{i}
$$

Here, there are $n=6$ data points. Adding up all the points in the data set, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{i=1}^{6}{x}_{i} & =(c-3)+6+3+c+10+20 \\  & =36+2c\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the mean is given by the expression

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{x} & =\frac{1}{n}{\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{x}_{i} \\  & =\frac{1}{6}\cdot (36+2c) \\  & =\frac{36+2c}{6}.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, since we're told that $\overset{―}{x}=11,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}11 & =\frac{36+2c}{6} \\ 66 & =36+2c \\ 30 & =2c \\ c & =15.\end{aligned}
$$
